Name: No Emo Hair Sebastian for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of hybridrainbow's No Emo Hair Sebastian mod and for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of using an XNB mod here: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods[/url]

Sebastian: now with two ears! (and shorter hair)

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure
you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher
1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!
